# 抖音运营关键词

## 概述

本章围绕抖音运营场景组织英语词汇，分为内容创作、流量与算法、电商直播、账号运营四个部分。它帮助读者用英语描述短视频平台的内容生产与运营动作，尤其是流量机制和直播带货相关的说法。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合日常沟通与运营文档。建议把内容创作与流量术语结合学习，理解平台运营的核心逻辑。

## 内容创作

| 词汇                 | 词性  | 含义   | 常用搭配                                   |
| -------------------- | ----- | ------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| 短视频 (short video) | n.    | 短视频 | short video content, create short videos   |
| 直播 (livestream)    | n./v. | 直播   | go live, livestream session                |
| 脚本 (script)        | n.    | 脚本   | video script, write a script               |
| 剪辑 (editing)       | n./v. | 剪辑   | video editing, post-production editing     |
| 封面 (thumbnail)     | n.    | 封面   | design a thumbnail, eye-catching thumbnail |
| 字幕 (subtitle)      | n.    | 字幕   | add subtitles, auto-generated subtitles    |

### 听说例句

> A: How long should our short videos be for the Douyin campaign? B: 15 to 30 seconds performs best. Make sure the thumbnail is eye-catching and add subtitles for accessibility.

> A: Do we need a script for the livestream? B: At least an outline. We'll cover product demos, Q&A, and a flash sale segment.

### 写作表达

- The content team produces an average of 20 short videos per week, each with professionally designed thumbnails.
- Adding subtitles to all video content has improved viewer retention by 18%.

---

## 流量与算法

| 词汇                                | 词性 | 含义      | 常用搭配                                       |
| ----------------------------------- | ---- | --------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| 流量 (traffic)                      | n.   | 流量      | organic traffic, paid traffic                  |
| 推荐算法 (recommendation algorithm) | n.   | 推荐算法  | algorithm optimization, recommendation feed    |
| 完播率 (completion rate)            | n.   | 完播率    | video completion rate, improve completion rate |
| 互动率 (engagement rate)            | n.   | 互动率    | boost engagement, engagement metrics           |
| 曝光 (impression)                   | n.   | 曝光/展示 | total impressions, increase impressions        |
| 标签 (hashtag/tag)                  | n.   | 标签      | trending hashtag, add tags                     |

### 听说例句

> A: Why is our engagement rate dropping? B: The completion rate is low — viewers drop off in the first 3 seconds. We need stronger hooks.

> A: Should we use trending hashtags? B: Yes, combine trending tags with niche-specific ones to maximize impressions and organic traffic.

### 写作表达

- The recommendation algorithm prioritizes content with high completion rates and strong engagement metrics.
- Optimizing the first three seconds of each video is critical for improving both impressions and organic traffic.

---

## 电商直播

| 词汇                     | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                                    |
| ------------------------ | ---- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| 带货 (live commerce)     | n.   | 直播带货 | live commerce session, live selling         |
| 选品 (product selection) | n.   | 选品     | product selection strategy, curate products |
| 坑位费 (slot fee)        | n.   | 坑位费   | slot fee negotiation, per-slot pricing      |
| GMV                      | n.   | 成交总额 | GMV target, daily GMV                       |
| 转化率 (conversion rate) | n.   | 转化率   | improve conversion, conversion optimization |
| 复购率 (repurchase rate) | n.   | 复购率   | increase repurchase, loyal customers        |

### 听说例句

> A: What's the GMV target for tonight's live commerce session? B: We're aiming for 500K RMB. Product selection is key — we've curated 30 items with strong conversion history.

> A: How do we improve the repurchase rate? B: Focus on product quality and post-purchase follow-ups. A loyalty program could also help.

### 写作表达

- The live commerce session achieved a GMV of 1.2 million RMB with a conversion rate of 12%.
- A data-driven product selection strategy has been instrumental in boosting both conversion and repurchase rates.

---

## 账号运营

| 词汇                      | 词性 | 含义     | 常用搭配                               |
| ------------------------- | ---- | -------- | -------------------------------------- |
| 粉丝 (followers)          | n.   | 粉丝     | gain followers, follower growth        |
| 人设 (persona)            | n.   | 人设     | brand persona, maintain persona        |
| 账号矩阵 (account matrix) | n.   | 账号矩阵 | multi-account strategy, account matrix |
| 私域 (private domain)     | n.   | 私域流量 | private traffic, build private domain  |
| DOU+                      | n.   | DOU+投放 | DOU+ campaign, boost with DOU+         |
| 蓝V (verified business)   | n.   | 企业认证 | blue V certification, business account |

### 听说例句

> A: Should we invest in a DOU+ campaign to boost this video? B: Let's wait 24 hours to see organic performance first. If engagement is good, DOU+ will amplify it.

> A: How is our account matrix performing? B: The main blue V account has strong follower growth. We're building two niche accounts to capture private domain traffic.

### 写作表达

- A well-defined brand persona ensures consistency across all content and strengthens follower loyalty.
- The account matrix strategy leverages multiple themed accounts to maximize reach and funnel users into the private domain.
